stage1.impression: A moody, coherent-looking long view down a timber-beamed bar with real depth, haze and pools of light; the counter, record wall and banquette read as a specific room rather than a catalogue bar. But at 1:1 it reads as CG: the floor carries large blotchy stain decals, the Orbs are blown white balls, the neon-bright multicolour rings of the hanging globe read as nightclub signage, the frame is grainy with denoiser smear, the right-hand frame edge is a crushed black slab, and no EARF speaker is legible as the hero. As it stands a magazine would see a well-composed concept render of a plausibly specific place, not a photograph it would publish.

blocking_9: A Tropos speaker must be the legible hero: the altar pair or the niche pair lit so silhouette, smoke tint and light through the acrylic read at a glance (speaker region lum_median >= 45, not black slabs)
Floor must read as one continuous polished concrete with fine aggregate, not large dark blotch decals
Orbs must read as smoked acrylic with a glowing liner, not clipped white spheres (median ~228)
Mother EARF's rims must read as glowing polished edges of thick cast acrylic, not neon tubes
No region over a tenth of the frame more than half crushed (right edge 1005-1200 is 52.6% crushed)
Noise and denoiser smear gone at full 2400x1600
The floor should not be the brightest large plane; light should pool on the bar top, tables and speakers

defects.what: large irregular dark stain blotches on the concrete floor that read as a texture decal or wet patches, repeated near every table
right frame edge is a near-black mass (lum_median 2.6, crush 52.6%), no detail in the object or wall
left frame edge is a dark, illegible block (lum_median 6.8)
foreground Orb reads as a flat white ball (median 228, neutral white), smoke tint lost
foreground Orb reads as a flat white ball (median 227), smoke tint lost
Mother EARF rims glow like thin neon tubes; the 25 mm cast discs read thin and faint between the rims
the Tropos speakers in the back bar niches are small and dark, illegible as the product
frosted screens glow as flat uniform lightboxes, a little lilac (r111 g88 b86), reading as signage
pale flat rectangle behind the pendants at the far end (median 156) reads as a backdrop card
counter top near clipping (p95 251), flat white highlights
visible grain and denoiser smear on glasses, pendants and the mirrored EARF lettering
record wall timber reads pink/salmon and smooth, without grain

changes.problem: No EARF speaker reads as the hero: the dark verticals framing the right and left edges are crushed and the niche pair is small and dark.

change.setting: lamps: the altar 2 x spot and the area lamps on each speaker
change.from: altar spots 170 W, cone 30 deg; speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2
change.to: aim the altar spots so a grazing pool lands on the speaker faces visible in frame (or reposition camera slightly so one altar speaker is in frame, lit); speaker area lamps 4.0 W/m2 at 2700 K; record wall spots 6 W -> 12 W aimed into the speaker niches

changes.expected: a speaker's smoked acrylic and inner batts legible with glow through the cabinet; the right-edge mass lifts out of crush

changes.problem: The floor's large dark blotches read as a stain decal or puddles, the single biggest CG tell, and the floor is the brightest large plane.

evidence.measured: lum_median 80.9, lum_range 140.7, dark blotches 100-200 px across beside each table

change.setting: the floor's finish (concrete tone and polish)
change.from: stained concrete with large dark mottling, fairly bright
change.to: remove the large stain layer; use fine aggregate and subtle trowel mottling at <= 30 cm scale, contrast low; darken the tone ~30%; satin polish (roughness ~0.35) so the Domes and Orbs make soft reflections

changes.expected: a continuous, darker polished concrete floor with soft light pools under the tables and reflections of the practicals

changes.problem: The Orbs are blown white balls, losing their smoked acrylic and frosted liner.

evidence.measured: lum_median 227, r230 g227 b222 (neutral white); other Orb [95,705,155,760] median 228

changes.expected: Orbs read as smoky warm-grey domes with a brighter liner core, not white; the tint visible

changes.problem: Mother EARF's rims read as neon tubes rather than the polished edges of thick cast acrylic, which tips the room toward nightclub.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 128 on saturated rims against a median of 38; the disc faces are near invisible

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow and hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.025, hard spot 135 W cone 20 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.012; hard spot 180 W so the discs are lit by transmission and their faces catch the spot, rims glowing by edge-piping rather than emission

changes.expected: the discs read as thick tinted slabs with brighter edges; colour stays, neon look goes; coloured shadow on the wall stronger

changes.problem: Grain and denoiser smear across the frame read as render.

evidence.measured: visible speckle on dark walls and smeared glass and lettering at 3x crop

change.to: 1024 samples, adaptive 0.008, clamp 10 kept; add a fine film grain in post instead of render noise

changes.expected: clean glasses and lettering edges, uniform fine grain

changes.problem: The counter top and far-end pale rectangle are the hottest flats and pull the eye from the speakers; the counter nears clipping.

evidence.measured: lum_median 150, p95 251, clip 0.36%; far rectangle [720,330,805,445] median 156

change.to: 22 W, cone 24 deg; Dome liner glow 0.05 -> 0.035

changes.expected: bar top a warm pool that holds texture, glasses catching highlights without white flats

changes.problem: The frosted screens glow as uniform lilac lightboxes that read as signage.

evidence.measured: lum_median 92, r111 g88 b86 (cooler than the room)

change.to: 0.018, and the frosted acrylic roughness raised so the image is softer

changes.expected: screens become dim warm glowing panels sitting in the wall, not lightboxes

changes.problem: The record wall and niche timber reads pink and smooth, without grain.

evidence.measured: r117 g84 b63 with salmon cast on the niche boxes; no visible grain at 4x

change.to: a warmer, darker brown stain (about 20% darker, less red), with visible open grain

changes.expected: niches read as stained oak cabinetry, browner, and the speakers inside stand out against them

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF a single tint or less saturated so the speaker is the frame's only colour
out_of_scope.why: Its six colours and shape are the owner's choice and fixed on the card; only its light levels may change (addressed in c4).

out_of_scope.request: Bring a Tropos speaker larger into the composition or move one to a better-lit position
out_of_scope.why: The altar and niches are fixed room design; only the camera and light may change, and moving the camera would change the frame's brief of the whole room.
